meta.title: Approve button opens a correct email in Apple Mail / phone mail app
gaps: Open the approval request in Apple Mail or a phone mail app and click Approve.
Verify that a new email is addressed to the company approval mailbox.
Verify the subject is formatted as Action:Approve|Proposal:[...] with literal brackets and pipe characters rather than encoded values.
Verify the body contains '(Required) Comment:' followed by 'This is a system-generated message, content after this will be ignored'.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open the approval request in Apple Mail or a phone mail app and click Approve.; Verify that a new email is addressed to the company approval mailbox.; Verify the subject is formatted as Action:Approve|Proposal:[...] with literal brackets and pipe characters rather than encoded values.; Verify the body contains '(Required) Comment:' followed by 'This is a system-generated message, content after this will be ignored'.
